span.p:
1. Key Vault & Signer
Generates BIP39 Mnemonic
to derive Ed25519 key pair.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.i: Data never leaves the user's device.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. SVG Attestation Logic
Client-side hashing (SHA-256) for C2PA hard-binding.
Injects signed JSON-LD manifest into SVG metadata.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. Live Assistant UI (React SPA)
Handles user interaction for both
voice and text chat.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. Trident Engine (Client-Side)
Core logic for analysis and orchestration.

span.p:
Firebase Hosting
Serves the static React SPA.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cloud Function (Drive Extractor)
Extracts frames from Google Drive videos.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Firestore Database
Stores: Public Key Registry
Provenance Manifests & Hashes.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Gemini REST API
Provides standard text-based generation
and analysis for Trident Engine.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Gemini Live API (WebSockets)
Provides real-time, bidirectional
audio streaming for voice chat.
